verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device inference engine, so x86 SIMD and matrix-extension acceleration is a fair axis to judge. The evidence only shows that it runs on x86 CPUs without a GPU and that it has a benchmark command. Nothing mentions AVX, AVX2, AVX512, AMX or any instruction-set-specific optimization, and running on x86 is not the same as using those instruction sets.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can leverage advanced x86 CPU instruction sets like AVX, AVX2, AVX512, and AMX for faster inference
